description.narrative: The expected impact of the Project is increased growth potential of and reduced poverty in the selected local authorities LAs) of Sri Lanka. The expected outcome is improved urban environments, long-term improvement of the economy, and improved living conditions for the LA population outside Colombo. The Project will (i) improve urban management, planning, and financing capacity of the sector institutions, especially LAs, to ensure sustainable provision of urban infrastructure services; (ii) enhance urban livelihoods; and (iii) increase Government and LA staff capacity for administering urban infrastructure supply and maintenance works.

description.narrative: Improved urban management and living conditions for LA population outside of Colombo.

About 50 LAs able to borrow from LLDF Progress/Status: LLDF has approved loan to 109 LAs.
Recent develoments in LLDF: (i) higher autonomy granted to LLDF about the approval of loans for local authorities; (ii) technical committees in four provinces have been established to look into the potential of loan recovery from defaulted local authorities in the past; debt write-off may be considered, if justifiable, for a cabinet approval. Actual value:

About 80 subprojects implemented Progress/Status: Out of the total 185 civil works/equipment contracts, 128 subprojects are being implemented and are in different stages of implementation. Actual value:
Citizen redress system used in 30 LAs Actual value:
FLIP adopted and implementd by at least 30 LAs Progress/Status: 109 LAs have implemented FLIPs. Actual value:

About 30 participating LAs increase their financial viability and own-source revenues by 40% by end of Project above baseline established at end of year 1. Progress/Status: Details of 32 LAs have achieved the target as collected from SPCUs and LAs. Data Source: PPMS Central Bank annual report and local government budgets LLDF annual reports LA annual reports Base year: 2005 Baseline value: N
Development and use of operation and appraisal manual, etc. for LLDF Progress/Status: Draft Operation and Appraisal Manual prepared by TA Consultants. Base year: 2005 Baseline value: N
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Actual value:

Annual accounts are also being updated. SLILG also is supporting through the project in assisting few weak LAs in finalizing the annual accounts under phase 2 of the Capacity Building program. Actual value:

Actual value:
